fields.summary_ko.0: Lucid Group (LCID) received an additional $1.75B credit facility from Saudi PIF, bringing total liquidity to $3.75B, sufficient to cover operating cash needs through Q4 2027.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 net loss was $830.9M against revenue of $350.3M, but cash burn decreased 30% quarter-over-quarter, while total debt surged to $1.69B from the beginning of the year.
